faqs.question: What is Nyghto?
faqs.answer: Nyghto (nyghto.in) is an independent digital product design and software engineering studio. We build bespoke web applications, native iOS & Android apps, multi-tenant SaaS platforms, and enterprise ERP systems with uncompromising craft and speed.

faqs.question: Where is Nyghto located?
faqs.answer: Nyghto is based in Kerala, India (Malappuram & Kochi). We partner directly with local startups and enterprises across India, as well as high-growth ventures and founders globally across the US, UK, Europe, and Asia.

faqs.question: What live production projects has Nyghto built?
faqs.answer: We have engineered and shipped production platforms including Alchemy Taste The Magic (alchemytastethemagic.in), FixOwe (fixowe.com), and EcoShopy (ecoshopy.com).

faqs.question: What technologies and frameworks does Nyghto use?
faqs.answer: Our core tech stack includes Next.js 15, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, Swift (iOS), Kotlin (Android), React Native, and TailwindCSS, deployed on scalable Edge CDN infrastructure with 100/100 Core Web Vitals.

faqs.question: How affordable are Nyghto's development services?
faqs.answer: We believe elite software design and engineering should be accessible. By operating with lean, direct founder-level collaboration and zero middle-management bureaucracy, we deliver world-class products at transparent, competitive rates for startups and scaling businesses.

faqs.question: How can I contact the Nyghto team?
faqs.answer: You can message our founders directly on WhatsApp Business (+91 85905 64004), email us at hello@nyghto.in, or call our direct phone lines: +91 85905 64004, +91 80759 11860, or +91 95392 02847.

faqs.question: Is Nyghto related to "Nighto" or other entities?
faqs.answer: No. Nyghto (spelled N-Y-G-H-T-O, official website https://nyghto.in) is an independent digital product design and software development studio founded in Kerala, India. It specializes in web applications, iOS/Android mobile apps, SaaS, and ERP software.
